personas.name: Solo Binge-Laugher On-the-Go
personas.description: Young solo-living adults in their late twenties who stream frequently throughout the week, almost always on mobile, gravitating heavily toward comedy series with autoplay running nonstop — often on ad-supported plans but showing signs of willingness to upgrade.
personas.jtbd: When I have downtime between daily obligations, I want to instantly drop into a light, funny show I can watch alone on my phone without having to think about what's next.

personas.name: Binge-Hooked Solo Streamer
personas.description: Young solo viewers in their late 20s who watch heavily across many weekly sessions, obsessively follow reality and drama series from start to finish, rewatch favorites often, and stick with an ad-supported tier without much churn risk or price concern.
personas.jtbd: When I have downtime, I want to dive deep into gripping series and reality shows I can follow episode by episode, so I always have something compelling queued up that feels like 'my shows.'

personas.name: Lapsed Casual News Grazers
personas.description: Older subscribers who drift in rarely — roughly once a week or less — and haven't opened the app in weeks. They lean toward news and sports over scripted content, are price-sensitive, sit on ad-supported plans, and show signs of churn through repeated cancel-page visits and low satisfaction with recommendations.
personas.jtbd: When I have a spare moment, I want to quickly catch up on the latest news or a live sports highlight without committing to a long show or paying more than I feel the service is worth.

personas.name: Mobile Casual Reality Browsers
personas.description: Young, recently joined solo viewers who primarily watch on their phones, favor reality TV, and graze broadly across content without finishing much. They're on ad-supported plans, open to upgrading, but haven't yet committed deeply to the service.
personas.jtbd: When I have a spare moment, I want to quickly dip into entertaining, low-stakes reality content on my phone without committing to anything long or heavy.

personas.name: Family Movie Night Planners
personas.description: Households of 3–4 people, typically with kids, who gather around the TV together to watch family films and movies. They are loyal, satisfied subscribers who rarely churn, respond well to promotions, and engage in long, immersive viewing sessions.
personas.jtbd: When it's time to wind down together, I want to find a great movie or family-friendly title that everyone will enjoy watching on the TV, so we can share a relaxing, connected experience at home.

personas.name: Binge-Focused Serial Devotees
personas.description: Young adults in their late twenties who watch frequently and return almost daily, concentrating deeply on a narrow set of TV series. They pay for premium ad-free access, show little price sensitivity, and engage solo across mobile and larger screens.
personas.jtbd: When I have downtime, I want to dive deep into the shows I love so I can stay immersed in stories that feel personally mine.

personas.name: Family Couch Comedy Night
personas.description: Larger households of parents in their late 30s who gather around the TV together most evenings, favoring comedies and dramas they can watch as a group. They are loyal, low-churn premium subscribers who finish what they start and respond well to promotional offers.
personas.jtbd: When I sit down with my family after a busy day, I want a reliable source of crowd-pleasing shows we can all enjoy together on the big screen, so everyone unwinds and we get quality time without arguments over what to watch.

notes.stability_method: per_cluster_jaccard (bootstrap Jaccard, clusterboot-style classify-all variant; Hennig interpretation bands): per-persona stability lives on Persona.stability; bands ≥0.85 highly stable, ≥0.75 valid, ≤0.5 dissolved. overall_stability is the coarse mean-ARI, retained for back-compat.
